settings.title: How to feed raw seafood, the simple way

settings.editor: Portion sizes, a gradual switch-over plan and safe storage tips — everything you need to start your pet’s raw journey with confidence.

settings.title: Feeding raw in three easy steps

settings.editor: You don’t need to be a nutrition expert. Start with your pet’s weight, work out a daily amount, and split it into meals.
Start with your pet’s ideal adult body weight. If you’re unsure what that is, your vet can help.
Most healthy adult pets need about 2–3% of their ideal body weight in raw food each day.
Divide the daily amount into two meals for most dogs, or two to three smaller meals for cats and small dogs.

settings.title: How much does my pet need?

settings.html:
Suggested daily amount

250 g per day

That’s about 125 g per meal, split across 2 meals.

A starting point for healthy adult pets only. Puppies, kittens, pregnant or nursing pets and pets with health conditions have different needs — please check with your vet.

settings.title: Make the switch gradually over 7–10 days

settings.editor: Changing food too quickly can upset sensitive tummies. Increase the share of raw seafood a little at a time, and slow down if your pet needs longer.

settings.html:
Days 1–3

25% raw

Mix a small amount of raw seafood into their usual food.

Days 4–6

50% raw

Half and half. Keep an eye on appetite and digestion.

Days 7–9

75% raw

Mostly raw now — slow down if their tummy needs more time.

Day 10+

100% raw

Fully switched. Weigh your pet regularly and adjust portions.

settings.editor: Puppies, kittens and pets with health conditions should switch under your vet’s guidance.

settings.title: Keep it fresh from freezer to bowl

settings.editor: Delivered frozen to preserve raw nutrition. Simply thaw in the fridge before serving.
Pop your order straight into the freezer when it arrives.
Move one portion to the fridge the night before. Never thaw at room temperature or in the microwave.
Once thawed, keep it covered in the fridge and use it within the time shown on the pack.

settings.title: Handle it like any raw protein

settings.editor: Wash bowls, surfaces and hands after serving, and pick up anything your pet doesn’t finish.

settings.title: Every pet is a little different

settings.editor: A few simple tips to help your dog or cat settle into raw seafood meals.

icon_list.text: Two meals a day suits most adult dogs

Be patient — some cats take a little longer to switch
